description: Search the allover.art catalog; returns one card per design (good_id, code, price, url) plus the total match count. Use it for any 'find me a …' request — list_collections is for curated themed pages, get_product for one card's sizes and fabrics. Filters combine: query is free text ('cat', 'neon koi'); theme is a canonical theme (Cats, Anime, Skulls; comma-separate several); style should follow the shopper's saved fit from get_user_prefs (basic → tee, oversized → oversized); max_price is USD. Ranked by relevance with a query, by best-sellers without. No paging: you get the top `limit` (default 24, max 48), so narrow the filters to reach the rest. Adult-only designs are excluded; an unknown color or style returns an error listing the valid values.

max_price.description: Only items priced at or below this amount, USD.

style.description: Garment cut: tee, oversized, long_sleeve or oversized_long_sleeve.

theme.description: Canonical theme filter (Cats, Anime, Skulls, ...); comma-separate several.

name: search_products

error.description: Unknown color or style, with the valid values.

total.description: Total catalog matches for the filters.
